figurative_meaning_en: Completely ruined; entirely fake or cheated
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই ব্যবসাটা তো ষোলকড়াই কানা হয়ে গেছে।
তার কথাগুলো ষোলকড়াই কানা, কিছুই বিশ্বাস করা যায় না।
example_sentences_in_english: This business has gone completely to ruin, like sixteen pots one-eyed.
His words are entirely fake, nothing to trust.
note: The idiom evokes imagery of total blindness or worthlessness, rooted in rural Bengali expressions.
